experiments.domain: Stack Overflow, Python (100 q, default tags)

key_finding: The 60% coverage floor is a domain-dependent boundary condition. Surmountable on Python-focused (~63%+) and Rust-focused (72%) Q&A, but not on JavaScript (57%), TypeScript (47%), Math (44%), C++/Go (54%), or Physics (28%) Q&A. Coverage correlates with question format: domains where practitioners ask 'how do I/to/what is' questions about languages/tools score higher.

reopening_conditions.classifier_with_coverage_floor: E119 declares anchored word-boundary patterns before measurement; G2 halts if coverage < 60%
reopening_conditions.coverage_gate_declared_before_run: G2 only scored if coverage >= floor, preventing the E113 defect of 28% screen reported as 100%
reopening_conditions.matched_harvest_as_default: Need and random arms drawn from same pool, sorted by view_count descending, addressing E113's delta 0.826->0.075 collapse

next_action_per_D083: Experiment with revised classifier tag subsets or pattern revisions on a new domain, then report results. If coverage reaches 60%, view-count line reopens for candidate generation; if not, coverage-floor limitation confirmed as boundary condition.
